name: eidoverse-worlds
description: Root deps serve server/optimize.ts (the store's GLB diet) and shared/protocol/sandbox.js (quickjs-emscripten, the runtime-script sandbox — lazily imported; the sequencer boots without it, scripting just reports itself unavailable). The sequencer core itself stays dependency-free. Client and mcpl keep their own manifests.
